verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no published Namecheap price list showing per-TLD registration, renewal and transfer prices. GetTldList returns per-TLD API capabilities, not prices. One community comment says only new transfers get special pricing and renewals are always at full price. That points to promotional first-term pricing, the opposite of this story, so it cannot support a positive verdict. The axis clearly applies to a domain registrar, so the absence of evidence makes this "none" rather than "na".

support.subject: As a founder, the full price list is published — registration, renewal, and transfer priced separately per TLD, with no teaser first-year price hiding a renewal spike
